title: probe ac5
description: TAT-3985: on an isolated BTC testnet position (Trading account), add $20 margin, remove the offered Max and require exchange acceptance, then require the zero-removable explanation on a fresh SOL position; pre-submit re-validation is proven by focused tests. Cross margin order placement moved to its own PR.

setup-session.intent: Select the funded Trading account on Hyperliquid testnet where the isolated BTC position lives

setup-pin-screen-variant.intent: Pin the full-screen margin flow this recipe drives; the screen-vs-bottom-sheet A/B test otherwise picks per slot

setup-assert-position.intent: Converge the isolated BTC long the margin flow acts on, opening one if the testnet account has none

ac5-pin-bottom-sheet.intent: Switch to the bottom-sheet margin flow the review finding is about

ac5-add-home.intent: Reset navigation so the market screen is the only margin entry point

ac5-add-nav.intent: Open the BTC market holding the isolated position

ac5-add-wait-margin-card.intent: Make sure the position margin card is mounted before opening margin actions

ac5-add-press-margin-card.intent: Open the margin bottom sheet to give the position removable headroom

ac5-add-open-keypad.intent: Open the keypad to type the margin to add

ac5-add-key-2.intent: Type the tens digit of the $20 addition

ac5-add-key-0.intent: Type the units digit of the $20 addition

ac5-add-close-keypad.intent: Close the keypad to reach the confirm button

ac5-add-confirm.intent: Submit the $20 margin addition from the bottom sheet

ac5-add-assert-added.intent: Confirm the exchange accepted the addition so removable headroom exists

ac5-home.intent: Reset navigation so the market screen is the only margin entry point

ac5-nav.intent: Open the BTC market holding the isolated position

ac5-wait-margin-card.intent: Make sure the position margin card is mounted before opening margin actions

ac5-press-margin-card.intent: Open the margin bottom sheet on the position

ac5-press-remove-mode.intent: Switch the bottom sheet to Remove

ac5-open-keypad.intent: Reveal the quick-amount buttons including Max

ac5-press-max.intent: Keep a positive Max amount in the sheet before the limit drops

ac5-close-keypad.intent: Close the keypad so the retained amount is validated

ac5-assert-no-explanation.intent: Confirm margin is still removable before the live limit drops

ac5-drain-live-limit.intent: Remove the position's spare margin outside the open sheet so its live limit falls to zero under the retained amount

ac5-assert-explanation.intent: Require the zero-removable explanation in the sheet once the live limit reaches zero

ac5-assert-no-stale-error.intent: Require no stale error in the sheet in place of the explanation

ac5-screenshot.label: AC5: bottom sheet explains zero limit under retained amount
ac5-screenshot.intent: Show reviewers the bottom sheet explains the zero limit instead of a stale error
